meta.side: contingent liabilities (off-budget) — NOT part of the budget total
meta.headline: Gujarat's outstanding guarantees: ₹3,044 cr — 1.82% of revenue receipts; ₹16,956 cr headroom under the ₹20,000 cr ceiling. Outside the on-budget total — the part of the books the budget does not show.
meta.off_budget_note: Outstanding guarantees ₹3,044 cr (later proforma-corrected to ₹3,089 cr in the 2022-23/2024-25 reports) = 1.82% of revenue receipts. Finance Dept stated there were no off-budget borrowings (the off-budget table shows nil). Sardar Sarovar Narmada Nigam Ltd 40%.
meta.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year ended 31 Mar 2022, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 1 of 2023)
meta.caveat: Contingent liabilities, not budget spending — a charge on the Consolidated Fund only if a guarantee is invoked. NOT part of the on-budget total. Source: CAG SFAR (ex Finance Accounts Statement 20). RBI 'State Finances' guarantees statement = pending cross-check.
